title: scleria lagoensis subsp. canaliculatotriquetra
intro: Scleria lagoensis subsp. canaliculatotriquetra, commonly known as a type of aquatic plant, is a species within the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Scleria lagoensis subsp. canaliculatotriquetra include modulating the immune system, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antibacterial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
